description: Upload a built site folder to Krexel. Zips the folder, stages it locally, and POSTs to the Krexel orchestrator API. Returns a deploy_id (always) and preview_url. If the orchestrator is unreachable the response carries an `api_ok: false` flag with the upstream error — never fakes success.

folder.description: Absolute or ~-relative path to the built site directory.

framework.description: Build framework hint. Default 'auto' detects from package.json.

name: ship_site
